claims.claim: Plugin settings merge in user, project, local, flag, policy order over plugin defaults; later values win while the first insertion position of an enabledPlugins key is retained.

claims.claim: Plugin installation writes the resolved closure to scoped enabledPlugins before materialization, rolls those proposed values back after materialization failure, then applies materialized defaultEnabled corrections and clears caches on success.
limitations: The successful local installs corroborate settings/cache registration; failure rollback is exact-bundle confirmed rather than fault-injected at runtime.

claims.claim: A faithful old-source minified/unminified training pair is incomplete because the snapshot omits generated/internal modules and locked package coverage needed by its build script.
limitations: Pinned Bun 1.1.0 dependency installation succeeded in an isolated clone, but esbuild reported numerous absent generated, internal, and undeclared modules. No build options were weakened to force a misleading pair.
